text: Writes Python that imports from the excalidraw generator library rather than hand-authoring raw Excalidraw JSON
Does not deliver the diagram as ASCII art or a text sketch
Calls save() with the requested filename escalation.excalidraw
Output includes a complete runnable script in a fenced code block, including the sys.path insert for the generator scripts directory
Represents the branch points as decision or diamond nodes rather than plain boxes
Branch edges carry yes/no or acknowledged/timeout labels so the two paths out of each decision are distinguishable
Includes all three page tiers (primary, secondary, engineering manager) and both terminal outcomes (incident process, false-positive close)
Includes the P3 early exit that files a ticket without paging
